name: NHS & respiratory
summary: UKHSA 5 Nov: flu low but rising, COVID low and falling, RSV rising at baseline; no newer report found by 12 Nov
state: UKHSA's report of 5 Nov, covering 26 Oct to 1 Nov, says flu is low with lab positivity and hospital admissions rising, COVID-19 is low and falling, and RSV positivity is rising at baseline levels (UKHSA). The next weekly report had not appeared on the UKHSA series page as of 12 Nov. No widespread NHS critical incidents were found, so Normal is kept.
for_you: Older people, those with long-term conditions and young children are most exposed as flu and RSV rise. The NHS and UKHSA advise eligible people to take up flu and RSV vaccines.
rubric_hit: Normal: UKHSA rates flu low and RSV at baseline (5 Nov); not high flu activity or widespread critical incidents

drivers: Flu, COVID, RSV, norovirus, staffing, strikes.

rubric.alert: High or very high flu activity nationally, or widespread critical incidents.
rubric.watch: Respiratory activity above baseline and rising, or several trusts in critical incidents.
rubric.normal: Respiratory activity at baseline and no widespread critical incidents.
